title: Card Bill Pay
description: Stops a credit card bill being paid in a way that quietly costs interest by reading back, before Pay, what the chosen amount really does: anything short of the total (even 40 paise, unless the statement forgives that shortfall) loses the interest-free days on the whole bill and on new purchases, the minimum is turned into years and rupees of interest, and below the minimum or past RBI's 3-day grace it shows the late fee and the credit-bureau report, with one tap to pay the total.
stops: Minimum due paid, interest charged anyway
